imports_added: dispatchTaskEvent, getGroupEpochHook, reload, settle (from e2e/fixtures/two-party.js — all pre-existing exports, no new exports added)

tests_added.note: S2 adds command classes only; they are wired into the fc.commands array in S5. Test definition count is unchanged (still 1).

test_counts.note: Confirmed exactly 1 test definition (fanned out across chromium + Mobile Chrome + Mobile Safari = 3 listings). Unchanged from S1 baseline — zero regression.

acceptance_criteria_satisfied.how: CtCommand3P(actor: "A"|"B"|"C", title, description); check returns true only when m.actorIsMember(actor) && m.groupId !== null.
UtCommand3P(actor, title) accepts the three-actor type; run() asserts the post-update title via r.getTask(actor, targetId).title === title (guarded by if(task)).
ScCommand3P(actor, status) asserts r.getTask(actor,...).status === status AND status-enum closure (one of open|in_progress|done|cancelled), the A2 postcondition.
AsCommand3P(actor) asserts r.getTask(actor,...).assignee === pubkeyA (A4), mirroring the 2-party form; check additionally gates on m.pubkeyA !== null.
DtCommand3P(actor) asserts r.getTasks(actor).has(targetId) === false post-dispatch (deleted task absent).
RlCommand3P(actor) reloads r.page(actor), re-navigates to the shared group, and asserts every model-expected pre-reload task is present after reload (A11), mirroring the 2-party form.

Every toString() returns `${actor}.Verb(args)`: A.Ct(title), A.Ut(title), A.Sc(open), A.As(pubkeyA), A.Un(task), A.Dt(task), A.Rl() — actor is the literal A/B/C, so shrunk counterexamples print in the matrix DSL.

verification_questions_addressed.answer: All task commands dispatch via r.page(this.actor) and read postconditions via r.getTask(this.actor,...)/r.getTasks(this.actor). No pageA is hard-coded. Pubkey resolution goes through m.pubkey(this.actor), covering all three actors uniformly (the 2-party file used actor==='A'?pubkeyA:pubkeyB which only handled two).
Ut/Sc/As/Un/Dt all gate check() on m.tasks.size > 0; As additionally gates on m.pubkeyA !== null. fast-check prunes impossible commands rather than failing at run time.

The 3-party command classes are self-contained in e2e/tests/multi-user-3p.property.spec.ts. No edit to e2e/tests/multi-user.property.spec.ts (AC-X-NO-2P-CHANGE-1). No change to two-party.ts signatures — only additive consumption of existing exports (dispatchTaskEvent, getGroupEpochHook, reload, settle).

Per-command postcondition asserts for Ut/Sc/As/Un are wrapped in `if (task) { ... }` exactly as the 2-party file, so a transient non-delivery skips the per-command assert rather than failing the property spuriously; convergence is still caught by the S4 headline assertions at quiescence. Dt's absence check is unguarded because absence is the success condition. No new try/catch was needed (these are dispatch-through-hook events on the actor's own page, not MLS commit operations like Fd/Lg).

issues_encountered: S1 imported neither fast-check, uuid, nor the task-dispatch helpers — S2 added those imports. getGroupEpochHook was added to support the readGroupEpoch3P helper (needed for recordEpoch / S6 monotonicity wiring in S4/S5).
The single-group 3P model has no per-actor groupIdA/groupIdB, so readGroupEpoch3P is keyed on the single m.groupId for every actor (unlike the 2-party readGroupEpoch which switched on actor).
deferred_to_later_stories: S3: group-lifecycle commands (Cg/In/Lg/Fd/Rd/Sw) — these mutate membership/groupId and are not part of S2.
S4: headline assertions (assertC0_3P / assertS5_3P / assertS6_3P / assertS7_3P / assertS10_3P).
S5: wire all commands into the fc.commands array + fc.assert (this is where the S2 classes become live arbitraries).
